machine: owner's PC (K15 reference, Ryzen 7 5700G, 16 threads), 2026-10-02, other agents running

tests.name: a live lock heartbeat prevents overlap beyond the stale interval
tests.before: wall clock: 150 ms stale interval, 50 ms heartbeat, 450 ms real sleep; failed on busy CI runners
tests.after: manual clock (web/tests/support/manual-clock.mjs) passed as withPrimaryQueueLock's clock option; the clock moves only while the holder's heartbeat and the waiter both sleep
asserts: the waiter does not enter during three stale intervals (450 ms of lock time)
the holder's heartbeatAt equals the lock clock at 450 ms
the waiter enters after release without overlap
tests.control: new test: a holder that never renews is taken over at exactly 152 ms on the same clock (checks every 2 ms)

tests.name: test_worker_heartbeats_during_long_render_and_prevents_reclaim
tests.before: fake queue clock, but the worker's heartbeat timer and the wait for the beat ran on wall time
tests.after: one fake clock drives render_queue.datetime and render_worker.time.monotonic; the test waits for the worker's own beat (an event), not a wall-clock deadline
asserts: no heartbeat while the clock stands still
the first beat after the clock moves 10 lease lengths carries the new time
claim_next finds the lease live; the render completes and publishes
tests.control: with the loop's heartbeat call removed the test fails ('the worker heartbeats while it renders')
